headline: OpenAI faces legal scrutiny amid whistleblower death investigation
body: Parents of OpenAI whistleblower Suchir Balaji are contesting the suicide ruling in his death, intensifying scrutiny on the company amid ongoing governance questions. For healthcare AI vendors and health systems evaluating large language model partnerships, this signals potential risks around organizational transparency and due diligence practices. The incident underscores why healthcare organizations must examine vendor stability, internal controls, and leadership accountability when selecting AI platforms for clinical workflows. Healthcare leaders should factor organizational governance into vendor selection criteria alongside technical capabilities and regulatory compliance.
